name: pixi-pua-promo
description: Source of the pixi-pua promo video. Rendered in the browser and encoded with WebCodecs.

scripts.finalize: ffmpeg -y -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-2:LRA=11,alimiter=limit=0.79:level=disabled -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart pixi-pua-promo.mp4
